name: omnestro
description: Conduct local native coding agents around one mission, with independent review and recorded verification evidence.

interface.longDescription: OMNESTRO conducts your own Codex and Claude Code on one software-engineering mission, in an isolated copy of your project, with independent review, tests and recorded evidence. Nothing reaches your project until you approve the plan and apply the result in the OMNESTRO desktop app. Requires the OMNESTRO desktop app and an OMNESTRO account (free trial, then a subscription).
capabilities: Runs a mission with your own Codex and Claude Code subscriptions
One builder, builder plus independent review, or two competing candidates
Every mission works in an isolated copy of the project
Recorded tests, reviews and verification evidence
Nothing reaches your project until you approve and apply it in OMNESTRO
